text: The annual vacation allowance for full-time employees is 18 days. Remote work is permitted up to 2 days per week.
Effective 2026, the annual vacation allowance for full-time employees was increased to 22 days. The remote work policy was revised to allow up to 3 days per week.
Employees are eligible for the 401k match after 90 days. The health plan deductible is $1,500 for individuals.
Project Orion is owned by Dana Reyes. Project Orion belongs to the Platform department. The approved budget for Project Orion is $2 million.
The Project Orion budget was revised to $2.7 million following the Q1 review.
The Platform department relies on vendor Acme for managed cloud services.
Vendor Acme charges $48,000 per year for the standard managed services tier.
All production access requires two-factor authentication. Sev-1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.
